statements: Asherin has never received a National Security Letter, FISA court order, or any classified gag order.
Asherin has never installed, been asked to install, or had any logging, telemetry, or backdoor of any kind in the OpenVPN / Asherin Shield browser-side code.
Asherin has never handed over user identifiers, search queries, audit telemetry, or session data to any law-enforcement, intelligence, or third-party data broker.
Asherin does not store the IP address, fingerprint hash, or geolocation of any visitor on its servers. All audits run client-side in the user's browser.
If this canary is removed, replaced with a non-signed copy, or stops being updated within 30 days of valid_through, you should assume the platform is compromised and stop using it.

live_anchors.rationale: These are public, time-bound signals embedded by the operator at issuance time so the canary cannot be pre-signed.

verification.procedure: Download the canary JSON, the .sig file, and the public key. Run: openssl pkeyutl -verify -pubin -inkey asherin-canary-pubkey.txt -rawin -in aureon-canary.json -sigfile asherin-canary.sig
verification.timestamping: Issuance hash is also anchored to the Bitcoin chain via OpenTimestamps. See https://asherin.com/.well-known/asherin-canary.ots

warning: Not yet cryptographically verifiable: verification.public_key_url, signature_url, and the OpenTimestamps anchor do not resolve to published artifacts. Treat this canary as an operator statement of record, not as a signed proof, until those three files exist.
